entries.title: Failure classes and parking
entries.content: Failure classes and parking. migration 0143; `causes.py` new codes; `engine/failure_classes.py` (table + overrides); `rules.queue_health` + schema.json; `mark_failed_or_retry` decides by class on an engine connection (park / retry within the class budget / fail); `on_failure` records class and logs `parked`; the claim clears `parked_on`; job events carry `class`. **AC:** a `model_unavailable` failure with the model unhealthy parks with attempts unchanged; with the model healthy it retries as `unknown`; `nas_timeout` retries up to 5; `ffmpeg_decode` fails at once; an override row changes a clas

entries.title: Dependency watchers
entries.content: Dependency watchers. the leader loop: model, share and disk probes, the shm cooldown, `dependency_health`, release of parked jobs when healthy, the `park_max_hours` backstop. **AC:** a parked job is released within one interval of its dependency turning healthy; a down dependency releases nothing; only one worker probes.

entries.title: Missing files at the scan, access checks, requested re-downloads
entries.content: Missing files at the scan, access checks, requested re-downloads. `file_missing` → `dependency:share:<root>` when the root is down; the scanner's post-scan check (heal and requeue, or confirm); the `access_check` stage; `repair_broken` takes `item_requests` (`redownload`) even when automatic repair is off. **AC:** a file back on the share is requeued by the next scan; a confirmed one gets `missing_confirmed_at`; a readable access check requeues the video's failures.

entries.title: API: tile health and the failures list
entries.content: API: tile health and the failures list. `QueueSummary.health {state, failed_window, finished_window, failure_share, waiting[], needs_you, failing?}`; `GET /api/queues/failures` (filters, keyset paging, facets); `POST /api/queues/failures/actions` (`retry`, `ignore`, `unignore`, `rescan`, `remove`, `redownload`, `fix_path`, `path_map`, `check_access`) with audit; ignored items leave every count. **AC:** handler tests per action (admin only, audited, counts), a red tile only for a dominant signature over the share.

entries.title: Web: tiles and the failures page
entries.content: Web: tiles and the failures page. `QueueCard` states from `health` (Failing, Waiting, OK) with the Needs-you badge and links; `/queue/failures` with URL filters, groups, selection, bulk and per-item actions, the fix-path / path-map / access dialogs, the Ignored filter; en + ar strings. **AC:** vitest per state and action, a11y.

entries.title: Move today's failures
entries.content: Move today's failures. a one-time backfill on the leader (`app_settings` key `queue_health.backfill`): every open failed row without a class is classified; dependency/resource classes get a new parked row (released at once by the watcher if the dependency is up), transient ones under budget are queued again, the rest keep their failed row with the class (Needs you). **AC:** model failures become Waiting, missing files Needs you, fingerprint partial reads retried; idempotent.
